text:
Nora (CS): Quick health check for Argosy onboarding. p50 ~200ms, p95 ~1.1s, token cost ~2.2x baseline. Customer says results are accurate but latency is hurting conversions. Renewal in 45d. Asking for low-risk perf moves: quant, model swap, routing. Thoughts?
Arjun (ML Eng): short: go for an int4/q4 canary + parallel small-model test. Typical flow: 10% q4 canary + 20% redwood-v2-small test. We can usually get 20-40% cost/latency wins with minimal quality change.
Priya (Solutions): Argosy is on Dedicated eu-west-1, GPUs are 4x A10. Any hardware caveats? Also they use long context (3k tokens) for some endpoints.
Leo (Infra): long context means KV cache size matters. q4 reduces model footprint but increases per-token compute slightly. Biggest ops risk is cold KV cache causing p95 spikes after deploys 11 recommend a warmup traffic replay.
Arjun (ML Eng): propose routing canary policy: 
```yaml
routing:
  - match: region == "eu-west-1" && customer_id == "argosy"
    traffic_split:
      redwood-v2-base: 80
      redwood-v2-base-q4: 10
      redwood-v2-small: 10
    rollout_window: 72h
    metrics: ["p95_latency_ms","error_rate","quality_delta"]
    rollback_conditions:
      - error_rate > 0.8%
      - quality_delta > 1.5%
```
Priya (Solutions): for 3k contexts we should confirm q4 tensor layouts; I'll pair with Arjun to run a mem/throughput report.
Sam (AE): Argosy spelled it out: "if pages hang, we'll pause the contract." p95 target to de-risk renewal is <800ms.
Ethan (Observability): I'll add a canary dashboard and automated alerts. Proposed alerts: p95 >850ms -> #customer-success; error_rate >1% for 10m -> auto-rollback; eval_quality delta >2% -> notify ML eng. I can run synthetic warmup traffic pre-rollout.
Arjun (ML Eng): quick eval command (on their prompt corpus):
```bash
ci-eval run --model redwood-v2-base-q4 \
  --corpus argosy_sample.json \
  --metrics semantic-similarity,exact_match,bleu \
  --out out/q4-eval.json
```
This will give a delta vs base. Aim for <1.5% semantic-similarity drop.
Maya (CSM): Captured verbatim: "answers look right but waiting kills demos". I'll schedule a post-canary demo and set expectations for a 72h window.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-04-02T07:30:00Z at 10% q4 + 10% small. Health checks: p95, errors, quality_delta. Canary URL: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/argosy-3301234567
Nora (CS): Recap/action items: 1) Launch 10% q4 + 10% small canary (72h) w/ warmup replay 2) Arjun/Priya: mem & eval runs pre-rollout 3) Leo: warmup job and KV cache heat 4) Ethan: dashboard + alerts 5) Maya/Sam: customer comms + renewal note. If metrics meet rollback conditions, we auto-rollback and schedule next steps. Agree?
Priya (Solutions): Agree. Drafting the technical note for Argosy now.
Arjun (ML Eng): Building q4 artifact and running perf bench now.
Leo (Infra): Scheduling warmup replay ~30 minutes before rollout.
Ethan (Observability): Dashboard created, will paste link here shortly.
Nora (CS): Thanks team. I'll update the renewal tracker and flag execs if we hit p95 <750ms. :rocket:
